Fully welded, all aluminum cooker with a complimentary custom etched logo of choice and 5 stainless steel burner tubes. 180,000 btu per tube. Your water will boil within 8 min on the 10gal and 25min on the 30gal cooker!!

You get a free custom etched logo and we offer a lifetime warranty on our welds.
